questions: How many devices did you measure, and how many showed the e/4 period? The text describes one device ("The device was measured in a Leiden wet dilution refrigerator", p. 9), while the author contributions say "M.D.L. fabricated the devices" (p. 9).
If other devices or cooldowns were measured, why were they set aside, and how many cooldowns do the data in Figs. 2 and 3 span?
Which ranges of ADG voltage, magnetic field and side-gate voltage did you measure beyond the windows in Figs. 2 and 3, and how were the Fig. 2 windows chosen?
What does the second-best dataset at each even-denominator filling look like, for example a minimal-excitation map at another side-gate setting or field?

On p. 4 you give ADG periods "in the range 112 mV to 126 mV" for the e/4 states, but with "∆V1 = 233 ± 14.3 mV" (p. 15) the ratios 0.24 to 0.27 correspond to about 56 to 63 mV, and 112 to 126 mV matches the doubled-period regime (∆V/∆V1 ≈ 1/2, p. 7). Which periods went into the ratios? While checking numbers I also noticed "ν = −2/3" on p. 7 where the data are at 2/3, Fig. 3 panel references on p. 6 ("Fig. 3d,e for ν = 2/3", "ν = −1/2 in Fig. 3g,i") that are swapped relative to the caption, and suppression temperatures given as "approximately 60 mK" (p. 8), "between 50 mK and 70 mK" (p. 28) and "30 mK to 50 mK" (p. 30).

Your reference ∆V1 comes from ν = −1 at 10 T while the e/4 data are at 14 T. What ADG period do you get at ν = −1 at 14 T, and does the e/4 ratio hold if you normalize to that value or to ν = −4/3 at 14 T?

Could you report the charging energy and ADG lever arm from the DC-bias maps (Figs. S8 to S11, panels c) for the minimal-excitation data, and the sign of the stripe slope in Fig. 2a to d next to the ν = −1 reference, so the Coulomb-dominated reading rests on more than the period ratios?
Did you check gate leakage at base temperature, and did you repeat sweeps at ν = −5/2, −1/2 and 3/2 as you did at 2/3 (Fig. S13), to separate reproducible resonances from charge rearrangements?
